[package]
workspace = "../../../../.."
name = "semio-framework-mesh-engine"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "Pure mesh data, primitive construction, and Obj/Glb/Stl codecs — consumed only from artifact facet code (the mesh artifact's own mutation/inference internals) and from engine-to-engine callers such as brep tessellation. No authoritative state; no persistence; no public compute reachable outside a facet or another engine."

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "framework"
id = "mesh-engine"

[lints]
workspace = true
[lib]
path = "../../🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
semio-framework-value-derive = { path = "../../../🌱️value/✨️derive/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-pack-json = { path = "../../../🎒️pack/🔤️json/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
pack = { path = "../../../🎒️pack/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-pack" }
semio-framework-io-base64 = { path = "../../../🚪️io/🔤️base64/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }

[dev-dependencies]
# 🔬️ `MeshData` now has its own first-party `ToValue`/`FromValue` codec (ticket 26/09/01/
# RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS) — `serde`'s `Serialize`/`Deserialize`
# derive on `MeshData` is `#[cfg(test)]`-gated to a differential oracle only, never a production
# dependency of this crate.
serde = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-async-macros = { path = "../../../⏳️async/✨️macros/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
serde_json = { workspace = true }
gltf = { version = "1.4.1", default-features = false, features = ["utils"] }

[package]
workspace = "../../../../.."
name = "semio-framework-3d"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "Generic 3D geometry kernel - native B-Rep kernel, half-edge mesh, and BVH spatial index"

[lints]
workspace = true

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "framework"

[lib]
path = "🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
semio-framework-pack-json = { path = "../../../🎒️pack/🔤️json/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-value = { path = "../../../🌱️value/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-hash.workspace = true
semio-framework-job.workspace = true
semio-framework-mesh-engine.workspace = true
semio-framework-number = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-geometry = { workspace = true }
# 🧬️ `#[derive(ToValue, FromValue)]`, additive alongside serde
# (RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS, 26/09/01). This crate has no
# `semio-framework-os-kernel` dependency, so types here target `#[value(crate = "::protocol::value")]`
# (unconditional) rather than the derive's `semio-framework-os-kernel`-dependent default path.
semio-framework-value-derive = { path = "../../../../🔨️modules/🌱️value/✨️derive/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-replication = { workspace = true }
# 🔤️ `🥽️mesh`'s `HalfedgeMesh::to_json`/`from_json` route through `pack::json::to_json_string`/
# `from_json_str` (over `ToValue`/`FromValue`) instead of `serde_json::to_string`/`from_str`
# (RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS, 26/09/01).
pack = { path = "../../../🎒️pack/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-pack" }

[dev-dependencies]
num-rational = "0.4"
semio-framework-async-macros = { path = "../../../⏳️async/✨️macros/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
# 🧪️ Differential oracle for `🧿️collision` ONLY — proves our BVH triangle-mesh queries agree with
# `parry3d`'s. Test-only: never a `[dependencies]` entry, never reachable from a production target.
parry3d = "0.17"
# 🔬️ `🥽️mesh`'s `value_round_trip_matches_serde_shape` differential oracle ONLY — proves the
# first-party `ToValue`/`FromValue` codec agrees byte-for-byte with `serde_json`'s own encoding of
# the same types. Test-only, `#[cfg(test)]`-gated: never a `[dependencies]` entry.
serde = { workspace = true }
serde_json = { workspace = true }
